name: benmi-android-pos
description: Benmi Multi-Tenant Universal Android POS Tablet App with Remote Cloud Loader & Thermal Printing

scripts.sync: bash build.sh && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:prod: APP_ENV=prod bash build.sh && APP_ENV=prod npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:dev: APP_ENV=dev bash build.sh && APP_ENV=dev npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: APP_ENV=prod bash build.sh && APP_ENV=prod npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:apk:dev: APP_ENV=dev bash build.sh && APP_ENV=dev npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
